categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Kexin Mechanical and Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-end heavy process equipment and system integration. Its main products include large reactors, heat exchangers, towers, containers, nuclear power and military equipment, and oil and gas skid-mounted equipment. The company serves industries such as nuclear power, military, new energy, new materials, natural gas chemical, petroleum refining, and coal chemical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including multi-layer clamping integral wrapping, large thin-walled complex component forming, large spherical tank segment pressing, and CNC bending. It has mastered welding technologies for various materials such as carbon steel, stainless steel, nickel-based alloys, and special materials like Inconel 625 and Monel 400. The production process includes order-based manufacturing with strict quality control, advanced welding equipment, and digital and intelligent manufacturing systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic enterprises in the energy and chemical sectors such as PetroChina, Sinopec, China National Offshore Oil Corporation, China General Nuclear Power Group, and major chemical companies like Wanhua Chemical. The company also serves international markets including Africa, the Middle East, and Russia. Its products are used in downstream industries like refining, chemical, power, metallurgy, new energy, and new materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Sichuan Province, China, with operations primarily serving the domestic Chinese market, which accounts for over 97% of sales. It also exports products to international markets including Africa, the Middle East, Russia, Bangladesh, and Vietnam. The company benefits from its location in the western region of China, close to key natural gas and chemical industry bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sichuan Kexin operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and system integrator of specialized heavy process equipment. It procures raw materials such as stainless steel, carbon steel, composite materials, welding materials, and components from qualified suppliers and delivers finished equipment directly to end customers in energy and chemical industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on developing new products and technologies such as spent fuel transport containers, high-efficiency reactors, hydrogen compression devices, and solid-state hydrogen storage systems. It pursues advanced manufacturing, digitalization, and green production, aiming to expand into nuclear power, hydrogen energy, photovoltaic, and new material sectors. Collaboration with universities and research institutes is a key part of its R&D strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized high-end process equipment based on customer orders. The company follows an order-based production model with staged payments linked to production progress. Revenue mainly comes from product sales, with a small portion from technical consulting and engineering services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the high-end pressure vessel and process equipment industry, competing with thousands of manufacturers in China. It holds a strong market position due to its comprehensive qualifications, advanced technology, and extensive project experience. Internationally, it competes with established firms from the US, Europe, Japan, Korea, and India, but has achieved significant import substitution and market share growth domestically.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.5 billion, a 39.19% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 163.5 million, up 34.88%. Total assets reached RMB 2.39 billion, growing 31.23% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding order backlog and increased production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive product range, advanced proprietary technologies, and ability to manufacture large, complex, and high-pressure vessels with special materials. It emphasizes safety, quality, timely delivery, and cost control, providing integrated solutions tailored to customer needs. Its strong R&D capabilities and certifications enable it to serve critical sectors like nuclear power and new energy, offering products that meet stringent domestic and international standards.
